== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Zuckuss In Mist Hunter (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Zuckuss In Mist Hunter (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): the earlier slip and this slip as cut from the sheets at 300 dpi, the second scaled to the size of the first; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>23a32fe99911cf4063b9b7ad776662ff6f1f9d9c</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
